mapper.insert: INSERT INTO messages (message_id, conversation_id, sender_id, content, message_type, parent_message_id, metadata_json) VALUES (#{messageId}, #{conversationId}, #{senderId}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{parentMessageId}, #{metadataJson}::jsonb)
mapper.update: UPDATE messages SET content = #{content}, is_edited = true, edited_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
UPDATE messages SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociusmvcapp.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE message_id = #{messageId}
